_readme: Curated few-shot examples that steer script generation and calibrate the best-of-N judge. These are VOICE references, not content to reuse. Keep the lines you find funniest, delete the rest, add your own. Order does not matter. Only the 'roast' and 'parody' arrays are read (see web/lib/preferences.mjs); the top few of each are injected into the prompt.
roast: OpenClaw went from a weekend lobster project to an OpenAI acquisition, the fastest anyone has failed upward since crypto.
Hand an autonomous beta your messages, your files, and a shell. What could an agent with root access do?
It is not pre-revenue. It is pre-idea.
One user's agent picked a fight with his insurance company. They call that AGI.
The install is one honest line. curl, pipe, bash, pray.
parody: Hi, I am the Clawfather. My weekend project is now an OpenAI foundation, because nothing says personal like a walled garden holding a shell.
We are pre-revenue, pre-users, and if I am honest, pre-idea. But the deck is stunning.
Our top contributor is Claude, but he's got zero percent equity.
Setup is one line. curl, pipe, bash, no notes.
I scrolled our testimonial wall for six minutes and never found a single flaw. Suspicious, honestly.
